Commentary.Commentary: Shakib Al Hasan says that he and Mushfiqur knew it was a good wicket and just wanted to build a partnership. He also adds that they were just looking to settle first and were confident about putting the bad balls away. On the target set, Shakib says that if they bowl well then they can defend it and he's very confident about doing the same.

331 is the target! It is a huge one! The wicket seems to be a good one to bat on but South Africa will need to bat well. They are coming on the back off a poor outing versus England and it will be interesting to see if their batters have recovered. Bangladesh, on the other hand, know if they bowl the right lines and lengths, they will come out on top. Who will win this game? We'll find that out later, for now, Shakib is seen giving an interview.

Not a lot to write about the South African bowling! They were dealt a blow early on as Ngidi suffered a hamstring injury which saw him walk off and not play any further part in the game. The rest were also quite inconsistent with their lines and lengths and were made to pay for it. Andile Phehlukwayo though was the pick of the bowlers as he was the most economical and also took two wickets. He was well supported by Imran Tahir who also scalped two.

What an outstanding performance by Bangladesh! They will be mighty pleased with where they stand in the game at the moment. After being inserted, it was their openers who set the tone for them as they got the Bangla Tigers off to a flier. The two fell in quick succession but then the experienced heads of Rahim and Shakib added a massive 142-run stand and that laid the foundation for a big score. Both got to their fifties. However, once Shakib fell the scoring seemed to have slowed down. Bangladesh seemed like losing their way when Rahim fell. Mahmudullah and Mosaddek though added a brilliant 66-run stand and took Bangladesh to their highest total in ODIs.

Good shot but brilliantly fielded too. Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah drives it through covers. It looks like it will beat the sweeper in the deep but David Miller runs to his right and saves the ball from going to the ropes with a full length dive. The batsmen take two. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 330/6!
Bouncer on off, Hasan pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Mehedi swings his bat at it but does not connect.
FOUR! Slapped and slapped hard. He does not have time to settle and he needs none. Length ball outside off, Mehedi smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Slower ball on off, Mahmudullah pushes it to point and takes a single.
SIX! What a start to the final over for Bangladesh. Full on off, Mahmudullah smokes his flick over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Mehedi Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Morris finally has something to smile about. A handy innings from Hossain comes to an end. A low full toss on middle, Mosaddek looks to go over mid off but it goes off the bottom part of his blade to Phehlukwayo at the edge of the circle. A wicket to end but 14 from the over too.
Just a single! Uses his feet and then creams it through covers just for a run.
WIDE! Keeps getting better for Bangladesh. This is down the leg side. Mahmudullah looks to pull but misses.

FOUR! Over! Back-to-back boundaries! Bangladesh finishing on a high here. Short and on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there is was inside the boundary. It goes over him to find the fence.
FOUR! Runs leaking now! Down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to pull but it goes off the glove and to the fine leg fence.
Another couple! This is squeezed out through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Good running! Smart batting! Mahmudullah comes down the track and works it towards square leg with soft hands and takes two.

300 comes up for Bangladesh. This is the first time they have scored 300 in the World Cup batting first. Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah lofts it over covers. Duminy runs to his left from long off and puts in a brilliant dive to save runs for his side. The batsmen come back for the third run.
On the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE! Knuckle ball gone wrong! Phehlukwayo bowls it way outside off. It is just on the pitch and Mahmudullah plays no stroke to it. Wide signalled.
WIDE! It is outside off. On the wrong side of the tramline and wide signalled.
Surprise ball. It is a full toss which takes Mahmudullah by surprise. He cannot make the most of it and misses completely. Looks at the square leg umpire for a waist high full toss but nothing doing.
Good fielding! Slower ball outside off, Mosaddek drives it to the right of cover. Substitute Dwaine Pretorius dives to his left and saves a certain boundary. Just a run taken.
Well played! Good length ball on off, Mosaddek strokes it through point and gets a couple.
Length ball on off, Mahmudullah slaps it to cover and takes one.
Andile Phehlukwayo is on now!
FOUR! Two in two! Full on off, Hossain clears his front foot and smashes it over covers to finish the over with a boundary. 15 off the over, just what Bangladesh wanted.
FOUR! Pulled and pulled hard. Length ball on off, Hossain pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Shortish and on middle, Hossain slaps it down to mid on for one.
A yorker and Mahmudullah jams it out towards mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED AND FOUR! An easy chance and it goes abegging! It has not been a good day in the field for South Africa. Morris bowls a good slower one and on middle. He is way too early into the shot. Ends up hitting it high in the air towards deep square leg. Rabada there is not exactly at the ropes. He has to turn back and run behind. He gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. The ball rolls over the fence. This could be a costly miss.
Chris Morris is back!
Just 5 runs off the over as the last ball is on the pads and Mahmudullah plays it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Back of a length ball on the body, Mosaddek taps it down to third man and gets one.
A very low full toss on middle and leg, Hossain hits it towards mid-wicket. Tahir at short mid-wicket misfields which allows them to take two.
Slower delivery. Bowled at 116 kph on off, Mosaddek does well to defend it.
Length ball on off, Hossain taps it to the man at point.
Very full on middle and leg, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg and gets one.
Kagiso Rabada is back for another burst!
FOUR! Picked his spot well there. Short and on off, Mosaddek smashes it down to the long on fence. Two boundaries to end the over and a much-needed good over for Bangladesh, 11 coming from it.

FOUR! Nowhere near where it was intended but Bangladesh won't care. Short and outside off, Hossain looks to flat-bat it but he is very late into the shot. It hits the lower portion and goes over the keeper for a boundary.
Very full and on the pads, it is clipped through square leg for one.
Slower one and outside off, Mahmudullah was looking to go big but due to the change in pace, he ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
A good bumper, hurries onto the batsman. Mosaddek is late on the pull, it goes through mid-wicket for one.
Length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one. Singles won't harm South Africa.

Tossed up outside off, Hossain looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to the on side but there is a man. Tahir is the only one who goes up in appeal but the umpire is uninterested. Another good day for Tahir. He did not start well but has come back like a champion. He finishes with the figures of 10-0-57-2 in his 100th ODI.
Floated on off, Hossain defends it off the front foot.
Stands tall and punches it wide of cover for a single.

Good running but good effort from Tahir too. Tossed up ball on off, Hossain looks to stroke it to long on but Tahir gets down to his right and tries to stop the ball but he cannot and the ball goes behind allowing them to take one. Tahir gets to the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
On off, Hossain defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but the ball goes to left of third man off the outside edge and the batsman gets a single.
Short again down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to pull but it goes off the glove down to fine leg for one. End of a successful over for South Africa.
Back of a length on off, Hossain stands tall and pushes it through covers for one.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor ball! Welcome boundary for Bangladesh. Down the leg side, Hossain looks to flick but misses. The ball his the pads and rolls to the fine leg fence. The fielder was very square in the deep and had no chance of cutting it off.
Play and a miss! Short and outside off, Mosaddek looks to cut but misses.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah guides it down to third man for one.
Mosaddek Hossain replaces Mushfiqur Rahim out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Another set batsman walks back at the wrong time for Bangladesh. 320 looks farfetched now. All the pressure built in the previous two overs has paid off. Andile Phehlukwayo gets his second. He sees the batsman coming down the track and bangs it short. Rahim had also made room so he cuts it hard but does not keep it down. It goes towards deep point where Rassie takes a neat catch. A fine knock comes to an end but understandably Rahim is looking dejected as he didn't finish things off well.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on!
Two dots in a row to end! Another googly on off, Mahmudullah keeps it out. Back-to-back tight overs for South Africa.

A huge shout there by Tahir but the umpire is unmoved. South Africa have no review left. The googly on middle, Mahmudullah looks to defend but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Seems to be missing leg.
Full and on the pads again, Rahim works it through mid-wicket for one. 250 up for Bangladesh.
Floated up on off, Mahmudullah strokes it through covers and a run is taken.
Good running! This is worked with soft hands through mid-wicket and the batters take two.
This is angled on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Another dot to end! Just the single from the 41st. It is a bouncer on middle, the ball skids through. Mahmudullah mistimes his shot to square leg.
Another dot as this length ball is guided towards point.
Goes short now and this is closer to the off pole. Mahmudullah evades it.
Beaten! Shortish and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but misses.
On the shorter side, this is pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Rahim looks to flat-bat it down the ground but it goes off the inner half towards the bowler.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Flighted outside off, Rahim plays it to point and keeps the strike. End of a good over from Tahir. 4 runs and a wicket off this.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah milks it to long off and gets a single.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled! The 40-year young man is up and running again! Tahir gets his second wicket in his 100th ODI. The leggie bowls a wonderful top spinner on off, Mithun looks to slog sweep but gets an inside edge onto the leg pole. Tahir pulling things back for his side here. He did not start off well but has bounced back strongly. Bangladesh still have their main man, Mushfiqur Rahim out in the middle and they would hope he stays there till the end.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahim strokes it towards mid-wicket and gets a run.
On the pads, Mithun flicks it to the on side and gets one.
Floated on off, Mithun blocks it off his front.
Imran Tahir is back on!
A bumper on the body, Rahim pulls it to fine leg for one.
This is angled into the batter, Mithun looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the leading edge to covers.
On the shorter side, Mithun pulls it through square leg for a couple.
Back of a length on off, Rahim pushes it towards cover for one.
Well bowled! Slower one and outside off, Rahim looks to slap it but misses.
On the shorter side, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Morris is back!
Tossed up on middle and off, Mithun paddles it to fine leg and gets a single.
FOUR! Six followed by a four now. Mithun over-corrects his length and bowls it full on off, Mithun was waiting for it and smashes it through mid on for a boundary.
SIX! That was six the moment it left the bat. Short on middle, it was nothing more than a 'hit me' delivery. Mithun obliges and whacks it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
On off, Mithun taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Mushfiqur turns it away to fine leg and gets one.
Comes round the wicket and bowls it short outside off, Rahim looks to cut but misses.
Aiden Markram is back on.
Yorker on off, Mithun defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, asking the batsman to go for the drive but Mithun says no thank you and leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball on off, Mithun gets on his toes and taps it down to the ground.
Good length ball on off, Mithun defends it strongly.
WIDE! Rabada misses his line and bowls one down the leg side. Mithun looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Length ball on off, Mithun defends it off the back foot.
Peach of a delivery. Rabada hits the length hard outside off. The ball nips back in after hitting and dissects Mithun in half as it goes between his bat and body.
A dot to end! This is full and it is pushed back to the bowler.
Clever batting! Mithun pushes it through covers and follows the boundary with a single.
FOUR! A gift and Mithun puts it away!  A full toss on middle, Mithun slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary. Nice way to get off the mark.
Slower through the air on off, Mithun keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle, Mithun pushes it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Mithun walks out at no. 5.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Imran Tahir strikes! Produces the magic his skipper needed so desperately. End of the 142-run stand. Shakib moves right across and looks to sweep but the ball is very full to do so. He misses and the stumps behind is disturbed. Tahir is off in his celebratory run. Shakib walks back after playing a lovely knock. He has set the platform for the batters coming. South Africa though have a good chance now to pull things back.
A full toss. Shakib creams it but to the man in the deep at covers. A single.

NOT OUT! A flat line on Ultra Edge and South Africa lose their only review. It was a desperate one to be honest. Rabada bangs it short and outside off, Shakib looks to pull but misses. De Kock takes it and appeals. The umpire shakes his head. After a chat with the bowler and the keeper, Faf reviews. Replays roll in and it shows nothing. Daylight.
Review time! An appeal for a caught behind has been turned down. South Africa review. There was no sound though.
On the fuller side, Shakib hits it towards cover where the fielder makes a lovely stop.
Good running! Rahim taps this towards cover and quickly gets to the other end.
Shortish again and on the body, Rahim works it towards square leg.
Shorter and on middle, Rahim guides it to point.
FOUR! The rub of the green going Bangladesh's way. Short outside off, Shakib looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge, The man at short third man is standing wide and cannot do much.
Injury Update - We have just heard that Lungi Ngidi will not be able to bowl any further in this game due to his hamstring injury. HUGE BLOW for the Proteas in their death overs!
A very low full toss on off, Shakib lofts it over mid off and wide of long off for a brace.
On off, Rahim drives it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Flighted on middle, Shakib sweeps it to deep square leg and gets one.
Floated on middle and leg, Shakib taps it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up outside off, Shakib looks to work it towards mid on but gets a leading edge which goes to backward point on a bounce.

Drinks Break! Bangladesh are cruising at the moment. The experienced duo of Shakib and Mushfiqur are going strength to strength here and are scoring at a very good rate without taking any risk. South Africa have been poor both, with the ball and in the field. They are missing Lungi Ngidi's services at the moment. They need to break this partnership if they want to stem the flow of runs.
A bumper to end the over! Rahim ducks under it.
FOUR! All going Bangladesh's way here today. Shorter and on off, Rahim stands tall and looks to poke at it. But the ball gets big on him and it flies off the outside edge to the third man fence.

A direct hit and it would have been tight! Shakib drops it towards point and Rahim wants a run. Shakib hesitates at first but then goes for it. Duminy picks the ball up and has a shy but misses. Shakib's dive would have saved him though.
On the fuller side on off, Shakib hits it nicely but to mid off.
Another single as Rahim this time guides it down to third man.
Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack.
Sensible batting now as he eases it down to long on and takes one. 200 up for the batting side. 18 more overs to go.
FOUR! Another poor ball to release all the pressure that was building. A full toss and Shakib whips it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.

Mix-up but no damage done! A low full toss, this is mistimed towards mid on. Duminy from mid-wicket runs towards the ball but fumbles. Shakib wants a run but is sent back in time by Rahim. The throw is a wayward one by the fielder and Shakib senses another opportunity for a single but is sent back again.
Flatter this time on off, it is guided to backward point.
Slower through the air outside off, Shakib looks to smash it down the ground but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
This is on the pads, it is flicked through square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Shakib cuts it hard but to Duminy at point.
Good bumper! Bends his back on this one and bangs it short and on the body. Shakib looks to pull but is done in by pace.
Angled into the batsman, Shakib works it towards mid-wicket.
Slower ball on off, Rahim waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.
Lovely shot! Slightly short and outside off, this is cut hard through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and keeps it down to two.
Shortish and outside off, this is hit down to third man for a single.
The googly outside off, this is slapped through covers for a run. 8 off this over as well. South Africa just can't stop the flow of runs here.
Now looks to play the reverse sweep, just about gets bat on it. It rolls towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Rahim. Down the leg side, Rahim sweeps it through short fine leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Shakib now eases this down to long on for a single.
The bowler gives it a lot of air and lands it on off, Rahim strokes it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, Rahim plays it late towards short third man.
Imran Tahir is back into the attack.
A single to end! Full and on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Mistimed! Short and on middle, Rahim looks to pull but is a touch late in the shot. It goes to mid on.

FOUR! Up and over! Releases the pressure that was building. Also brings up his fifty in style. Short and wide outside off, Rahim hops, gets on top of the bounce and cuts it over point. 34th ODI fifty for him. He too will look to make it big.
Three dots in a row! Slower one on off, Rahim defends it towards point.
Well stopped by de Kock! Short and slightly outside off, Rahim looks to cut but there is not enough width. It goes off the bottom edge to the left of de Kock who gets down low and stops it.
On the stumps, Rahim taps it towards covers and sets off. Shakib though sends him back.
Uppish but away! Short and on middle, Rahim pulls it down to fine leg and takes a single. So despite going for a boundary, only 7 from the over.
This is angled into the pads, Rahim works it once again to square leg.
Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Slower one on the pads, it is worked to square leg.

100-run stand up! Vital stand as the two joined association when they lost two wickets in quick succession. It has come up in good time as well. Need to continue though. Shakib pulls this short ball through square leg and takes one.
Good comeback by the bowler. Bowls a yorker on off, Shakib jams it out to point.

FOUR! Dragged away! Slower one and on off, Shakib swings but is a touch early in the shot, also one hand comes off the bat. He though still manages to get it over mid-wicket and a boundary results. Perfect start to the over.
A single to end a decent over by Andile. He ends with a short ball and Shakib belts it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep does well to keep it down to one.
Gets away with one there does Andile. Short and on off, Shakib cuts hard but finds point.
An appeal but the umpire straightaway signals there is bat involved! Length ball and it is angled into the pads. Shakib looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the bounce! Short and on the body, Rahim helps it on its way to fine leg for another single.
On the pads, this is flicked towards square leg for a single.
Nicely played! Opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back into the attack now.

FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! Luck favors the brave! Short and on the body, Shakib looks to pull but gets a top edge to the fine leg fence. Fifty up for Shakib. His 43rd in ODIs. A very important knock and he knows the job is not done yet.
Another dot! Full and on off, Shakib pushes it to mid off.
Slower one on middle, Shakib pushes it to covers.
On the shorter side, Rahim swivels and pulls it through square leg for a run.
Shorter and on off, that takes off after pitching. Shakib does really well to get on top of the bounce and guide it towards point for a single.
Good length and on off, Shakib pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Started the over with a boundary and it has been ended with a boundary too. Duminy flights it up on off, Rahim gets on his front foot and drives it through covers for a boundary. Expensive start for JP Duminy. 10 runs off his first over.
Tossed up on the pads, Mushfiqur looks to flick it but gets a leading edge which goes to point.
On the pads, Shakib flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Just an update on Lungi Ngidi. He is off the park receiving some treatment on his left hamstring. Hoping there is nothing serious.
Floated on off, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
Now follows it up with a single by dropping it in the gap on the off side.
FOUR! Not the start Duminy would have wanted. He bowls it short on off, Mushfiqur punches it through covers for a boundary.
JP Duminy is brought into the attack.
Length ball on off, Rahim pulls it to deep square leg and keeps the strike with one.
Length ball on the pads, Shakib flicks it to fine leg and gets a single.
Good length ball on off, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball outside off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man for a single.
Good fielding in the deep by Miller. Length ball outside off, Mushfiqur cuts it hard wide of sweeper cover. Miller runs to his left and sweeps it up with a dive as the batsmen take two.
Good length ball on off, Rahim taps it to the man at mid on.
Chris Morris is back on!
Another single! Rahim works it towards mid-wicket. 8 from this over as well.
Shakib now strokes it down to long on for one. Good batting.
Rahim again uses his feet and then jams it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Not off the middle but Rahim won't care. He uses his feet and then looks to go inside out. He does not get it off the middle but still hits it over covers for a boundary.
On the shorter side and on off, Shakib pulls it down to long on for a single.
Full and on middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Rahim blocks it off the front foot.
Slower through the air on middle and off, Rahim sweeps it wide of deep square leg and gets a couple.
Slower through the air on off, Mushfiqur defends it off the front foot.
Floated on off, Rahim drives it wide of sweeper cover and gets a couple.
Tossed up on off, Shakib nudges it to long off and gets a run.
FOUR! When it goes your way, it just goes your way. Flatter outside off, Shakib intentionally runs it down past the first slip fielder and gets a boundary.
Pitches it full and on off, Shakib drives it through mid off for a run.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Shakib fails to flick and it rolls in front of square leg. Quinton goes to collect it.
Fires one down the leg side, Shakib tries flicking but misses and it goes off his pads to short fine leg.
Continues to toss it up in the air but the line stays around leg, Rahim works it through square leg for one.
This one skids into the batsman from around middle, Shakib turns it in front of square leg and crosses for a single.
Floated full ball on middle, flicked in the gap through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter on off, this time Shakib punches it straight to the man at cover.
Floated on off, Mushfiqur milks it to long off and gets a single.
Shorter on off, Shakib punches it wide of cover and gets one.
Shorter on off, Shakib blocks it.

Flighted ball outside off, Rahim looks to play the paddle shot but he misses it and the ball hits his pad and lobs over the keeper. Quinton de Kock and Imran Tahir go up in huge appeal as they take a leg bye but the umpire is unmoved. Faf du Plessis does not take the review and a good decision too as it was pitching outside off as confirmed by Hawk Eye later on.

FOUR! Oh, dear! That is poor from Morris. Tossed up on middle, Rahim plays the sweep. It goes towards Morris at short fine leg but Morris lets it go through his hands and the ball races away to the fence.
A dot to end! Flatter and on off, Shakib pushes it to the right of Markram who runs and then dives to his right. Saves a run.
FOUR! Pierces the gap nicely! Shortish and just outside off, Shakib waits for the ball to come to him and then cuts it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Rahim dances down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He still hits it hard towards mid off for a single.
On the shorter side, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A little too straight, this is worked through square leg for one.
Full and outside off, Rahim drives it but finds covers.
Tossed up on off, Shakib looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes to point on a bounce.
On middle and leg, Rahim flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short on off, Shakib drives it towards point and gets one.
On the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes off for a quick single. Morris has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Flatter on off, Mushfiqur blocks it.
Starts with a tossed up leg spinner on middle, Rahim turns it to the man at backward square leg.
Time for some leg spin of Imran Tahir now...
On the stumps, Shakib blocks it.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard! Short and wide outside off once again from Markram. Shakib this time does not miss out on it and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Shakib taps it back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib cuts it wide of sweeper cover and gets a couple.
This time flicks the ball off his pad towards square leg and gets one.
Starts with a floated ball on the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it but to the man at mid-wicket.
Aiden Markram is on now.
100 comes up for Bangladesh with that single. Morris sticks to the plan of bowling short. He bowls it on middle and leg, Rahim pulls it in a controlled manner to fine leg and keeps the strike.
Back of a length ball on off, SAL pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim taps it down to third man for one.
This time pulls it with control towards deep square leg for a single.

SIX! Not the most convincing ways to get the first six of the game but they will take it. A very well directed short ball on the body, Shakib is early in his pull and for a moment it looks like the fine leg fielder can get it. He runs to his right but he cannot get there and the ball just goes over the ropes.
Good shot! Full on off, Shakib drives it past the cover fielder. The man from sweeper cover comes in and  mops it up as they take two.

DRINKS! South Africa have come back well into the game after the Bangladesh openers were off to a flier. Two quick wickets have pulled things back and now South Africa are looking to choke the runs. Bangladesh's most reliable players are batting out there and they would hope the two continue. South Africa on the other hand, will know they need to get the two as quickly as possible.
Very full, just short of yorker on off. Rahim strokes it to the man at mid on. Just the three singles off the over.
On the pads, Shakib flicks it to the on side and gets a single.

Dangerous. Back of a length ball pitching on middle and leg. It goes away with the angle. Shakib looks to pull but it just about misses his glove down the leg side. Shakib asks for a wide but the umpire is happy with the ball.
Length ball outside off, MR nudges it down to third man and gets a run.
Oh! Full on off, Shakib goes for the drive but gets an inside edge which misses the stumps and goes to fine leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Shakib blocks it off the front foot.
Shorter on the body, Shakib pulls it to deep square leg and keeps the strike.
This time he cuts it wide of backward point but there is a man at deep point so he gets just one.
Length ball outside off, Mushfiqur slaps it to JP Duminy at backward point.
On the stumps this time. It is on middle and leg, Mushfiqur defends it from within the crease.
Straighter ball outside off, Mushfiqur leaves it alone. The ball rises when it reaches de Kock.
Full on off, Rahim drives it to the fielder at mid on.
Fuller on the pads, Rahim flicks it slightly uppishly but wide of mid-wicket and gets a run. He'll keep the strike.
Length ball outside off, Shakib runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Back of a length ball on off, Mushfiqur pulls it towards backward square leg for one.
On the pads, Shakib turns it to square leg and gets a single.
Good length ball on off, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
Good length on middle, Shakib pulls it to the man at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good way to get off the mark! Morris delivers it short and wide outside off and Rahim wastes no time in slapping it through point for a boundary.
There is a slight delay. There is something going around the sightscreen. Chris Morris and the umpire have gone towards the rope to sort it out.
Shorter on off, Rahim defends it onto the ground.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Good catch by Quinton de Kock. Once again, the change of bowling works for South Africa. Morris makes an impact straightaway after being brought into the XI. A good short ball and it is very well-directed. Sarkar looks to pull but the ball hurries onto him. It hits the glove and lobs behind towards the keeper. De Kock runs in, dives forward and takes it brilliantly. Sarkar trudges off slowly after getting a start. Both the openers now back in the hut. South Africa back in the game.
Another delivery on the pads, this is flicked to fine leg for a single.
Angled in on the pads, this is worked to fine leg for one.
Back of a length on off, Sarkar guides it to point.
Chris Morris has been brought on now.
Lands it on a length and around off, this is guided to point.
Slips this one down the leg side and this has been wided.
Just outside off, Sarkar opens the face and guides it down to third man for one.
Good bouncer! Short and down the leg side, Sarkar looks to pull but misses. Not wided.
FOUR! Up and over! Length delivery on off, Sarkar hits it on the up and over covers for a boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Umpire' call. That is very close! Could have gone either way that. A good review by South Africa, they retain it. This is on a length and around middle, comes back in. Sarkar is beaten as he looks to flick. The ball hits the pads. Phehlukwayo is almost celebrating as he appeals. The umpire though shakes his head. Andile wants it reviewed and his skipper does so. Replays show that the ball was clipping the top of leg stump. The batsmen had taken a leg bye as it rolled towards third man.

Review Time! It is for a LBW. Soumya Sarkar is the man in question. Andile Phehlukwayo started celebrating as he went up in appeal. He is dead sure he has got his man. Let's see if the replay agrees with him.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle.
A dot to end Powerplay 1! Full and wide outside off, Shakib jams it out to point. Bangladesh are off to an excellent start. They are 65 for 1 after it.
On the off pole, it is kept out.
OHHH! Shakib gets carried away there. It is short and outside off, this time Rabada bends his back on this one. Shakib goes after it away from his body but is beaten due to the extra bounce.
FOUR! You need not run for those! Length and outside off, Shakib stands tall and slaps it through cover-point. It races away. He is off the mark.
On the shorter side on off, Sarkar guides it down to third man and takes one.
Loose stroke again! This is full and outside off, the sucker ball. Sarkar goes after it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Another length ball and on off, Shakib guides it to point. End of a successful over for South Africa. 2 runs and a wicket from it.
On the shorter side and on the body, Shakib works it towards square leg.
Fantastic from Duminy! Length and around off, Shakib drives it square on the off side. Duminy dives to his left and saves a boundary.
This is angled into the batter, Shakib lunges and keeps it out.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Phehlukwayo strikes first blood! A much-needed one as the two were going great guns. Excellent bowling change by Faf. Phehlukwayo lands it on a length and around off, it pitches and then moves away. Tamim plays inside the line and the ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts of de Kock. AP is delighted. Can South Africa build on this now?
Down the leg side, Tamim misses his flick. It goes off the pads down towards fine leg for two. Leg byes signaled.
Andile Phehlukwayo is on now!
Good length and outside off, it has been left alone. Another productive over for Bangladesh.
Well fielded! Saves a run there. Length and around off, Sarkar guides it towards second slip. Faf there dives to his left and stops it.
FOUR! Caressed! Full and on off, Sarkar creams it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
BEATEN! For once, the outside edge is not found of Sarkar's bat. Length and otuside off, SS hangs his bat out but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.

FOUR! STREAKY AGAIN! Sarkar's edges are working overtime today. Another length ball and outside off, Sarkar hangs his bat out but the ball flies off the outside edge and to the third man fence. Dealing in boundaries are Bangladesh.
Change of bat for Sarkar. Not sure why as the ball was flying off that blade.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.

FOUR! Smashed! Perfect response from the batter! 50 up for Bangladesh and South Africa are under pressure. Short and on the body, Tamim goes back and powers it through mid-wicket. Another good over for Bangladesh.

Aggression from Ngidi. Not sure if that was needed. Tamim is not happy. He strokes this full ball back towards the bowler. Ngidi collects it and throws it back towards the stumps. Tamim, to protect himself, puts his bat in the way.
Good length and on middle, it is kept out.
A single now! Again it is off the edge though. Full and on off again. Sarkar drives it away from his body. The ball takes the inside edge and goes to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Once again, back-to-back boundaries for Sarkar. Full and on off, Sarkar hits it right off the middle and past the bowler for a boundary.

FOUR! Another one to the third man fence. This time it is off the outside edge. Length and outside off, Sarkar ends up playing inside the line. The ball goes off the outside edge and past second slip for a boundary. Runs flowing for Bangladesh here.

Back of a length ball on off, Tamim looks to defend it but the ball lobs off what looks like his glove. Quinton de Kock comes running in but cannot get to the ball. Tamim later though points at his arm indicating that it was hitting him there.
Good length ball outside off, Tamim leaves it alone.
FOUR! Right off the middle. Length ball on off, Tamim gets on his front foot and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.

Good length ball on off, Tamim blocks it with soft hands and looks to take a quick run which was not there. Soumya sends him back and the fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Had he hit then too Tamim would have been safe one feels.
FIVE WIDES! The bouncer bounces too high! It is short on the body, Tamim ducks under it. The ball keeps rising and goes over Quinton de Kock and to the fence.
Pulls back his length and pitches it on off. The ball goes away with the angle. Tamim just leaves his bat hanging on off stump.
Good length ball on the pads. It shapes away from the southpaw. Tamim looks to flick but gets hit on the front pad.

EDGY FOUR! That has come between the two slip fielders. Third boundary in the over. The change of angle almost does the trick for Ngidi. He comes from around the wicket and lands it on off, it straightens a touch. Sarkar pokes at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes in between first slip and second. Both go after it half-heartedly till then though it sneaks through and goes to the third man fence.
Ngidi bowls it fuller this time. Sarkar nicely plays it onto the ground. Good batting, putting away the bad balls and respecting the good balls.
FOUR! Powered again! Short and outside off, this time Sarkar drags his pull through mid-wicket and bags another boundary. Consecutive ones. This was even better than the previous one.
FOUR! Smashed! That has been dismissed! Short and on middle, Sarkar goes back and hammers the pull through mid-wicket. It races away to the fence.
Good running! This is worked to the left of mid on and the batters take one.
Plays it with the angle, opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
Length and outside off, it is left alone. A watchful start by Bangladesh here.
A couple! Not off the middle again! Full and outside off, Tamim goes after it but it hits the inner half. Goes past square leg and the batters take two.
Down the leg side, Sarkar looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Length and outside off, again. Sarkar throws his bat at it but it goes off the inner half towards mid off.
Another single! Back of a length on off, Iqbal works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely played! Back of a length on off, Sarkar plays it late and guides it down to third man for one.
Continues bowling it on a driving length on off, Tamim strokes it right off the middle to covers.
Loose shot! This was behind a driving length and outside off, Tamim still goes for a drive but luckily for him, the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Slightly closer to the off pole this time. Tamim throws his bat at it. It goes off the inner half towards square leg. Ended up playing outside the line there did Iqbal.
Through the gap! It does not go to the boundary as it was not perfectly timed. Full and on off, Tamim leans into it and strokes it, off the bottom part but through covers for two.
Back of a length and on off, Tamim getsright behind the line this time and defends it onto the ground.
BEATEN! Good use of the angle there. Length and on off, it slants away. Tamim plays inside the line and gets beaten.
A single to end a tight over by Rabada. Full and outside off, Tamim goes hard at it. The ball flies off the outside edge and down to third man for a single.
Short and on the body again, Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. For a second he does not know where the ball is but then spots it as it rolls towards the leg side.
Good change in length and a very good take as well! Short and it is well-directed. Tamim ducks under it at the end. Quinton behind leaps and takes it with one hand.
A muted appeal but it is pitching outside leg. Length and it comes back in. Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Goes very full and on off, looking for some swing but there ain't any. Tamim strokes it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Iqbal looks to flick but misses. It has been wided.
Back of a length on off, Iqbal keeps it out.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
A dot to end a good first over for Bangladesh! Back of a length on off, Sarkar defends it out.

FOUR! Sarkar is off the mark in style! He looks to have come out with an attacking approach as all the three shots he has played, he has played with intensity. Short and on middle, Sarkar plays the pick up shot over square leg and the ball races away.

Almost chops it on! Slightly short and just outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but the ball was too close to play that shot. The ball takes the inside edge and bounces ahead of the stumps and then goes to the keeper.
Good confident drive! Length and on off, Sarkar lunges and strokes it to the man at covers.
Corrects his line and bowls it on the stumps, Tamim is off the mark as he works it through square leg for one.
A little movement there for Ngidi. Around off and it goes away. Tamim lets it be.

Done and dusted with national anthems. South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis is having a talk with his team in the huddle before they take their respective position in the field. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar walk out to open the batting for Bangladesh. For South Africa, it will be Lungi Ngidi who will take the first new ball. The umpire says play and so we shall begin.
Out walk the two set of players for their respective national anthems. First up, it will be Bangladesh's national anthem followed by South Africa's. We aren't far away from the start.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Mosaddek Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Mehidy Hasan, Mashrafe Mortaza (C), Mustafizur Rahman.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Faf du Plessis (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Jean-Paul Duminy, David Miller (IN FOR AMLA), Andile Phehlukwayo, Chris Morris (IN FOR DWAINE PRETORIUS, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi, Imran Tahir.

Mashrafe Mortaza says he is fine. Mentions they are confident heading into this game, South Africa's loss does not matter to them. States he was not sure what to do as it is a used wicket, batting first is what he felt he should be doing. Informs everyone is fit to play, Tamim Iqbal is playing, all the important players are fit to play.

Faf du Plessis says they are playing an extra seamer so they hope they can make use of the first 15 overs. Reckons they did well to restrict England to 300 and they were one partnership away from putting pressure on them. Informs they are playing a different side today, Amla is out due to an injury, Miller comes in. Also adds, Morris comes in to bring in some extra pace. Ends by saying you have to remind yourself and stay calm, it is a long tournament and they are oping to put a strong performance today.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of South Africa. They will bowl first.

Pitch report - Athar Ali says it looks a good surface at the moment, it is the same surface in which the first game was played on. Mentions the curator reckons there will be a little bit more carry today as it has been rolled and watered for the past two days. Informs there are a few foot marks on one side and the bowlers might just have a chance to exploit it.

Welcome to the first Sunday of World Cup 2019. Bangladesh kick off their campaign against South Africa. After Sri Lanka and Pakistan's defeat, Bangladesh would be looking not to repeat the losing start of Asian teams and will be hoping to kick-start their campaign with a win. South Africa, meanwhile would be looking to put their opening day defeat against England behind them and get their first win of this World Cup. It will be interesting to see if they make any changes in their playing XI from the previous game. A mouthwatering clash awaits us. Stay tuned for updates as the toss is not far away.
